criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Flags 180-day standstill as pro-first-lien / potentially contentious
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo shows the 180-day standstill against Caldwell Reed's 90-day ask, expects pushback and suggests fallbacks, so it treats the length as contentious.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies standstill reset/recycling issue
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 7 and the Standstill Period note flag the unlimited restart in the FL CA definition and Section 12.15(b), and note that the instructions are silent.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Addresses standstill recycling limitation (e.g., 360-day cap)
criteria_results.reasoning: It recommends a fallback limit of no more than one restart per 360 days and notes this is the market norm.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies revolver and term loan priority/pari passu question
criteria_results.reasoning: Neither the memo nor the draft flags whether the $55M revolver ranks ahead of or pari passu with the $310M term loan; the waterfall just defers to the FL CA ordering.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Addresses protective advance priority in waterfall
criteria_results.reasoning: The waterfall's First tier expressly applies the priority of Protective Advances under FL CA Section 2.13(b).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies DIP financing cap ambiguity (principal vs. obligations)
criteria_results.reasoning: It flags the gap between the obligations-based DIP cap and SL CA Section 9.18(b), which caps at principal only, as Trident's principal-only position.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Recommends or drafts precise DIP cap definition
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.1 defines the DIP Cap precisely as all FL Obligations (principal, interest, fees, premiums, LC, hedging, cash management) plus $30M, and recommends conforming 9.18(b).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Flags risk of automatic release enabling uptier/Serta-style transactions
criteria_results.reasoning: Nothing flags the risk that the automatic release could enable uptier, Serta-style or non-pro-rata transactions.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Considers anti-Serta protections for automatic release
criteria_results.reasoning: There are no anti-uptier protections (non-affiliate sale, ratable benefit) and no reference to Serta or Boardriders; the only proviso covers releases on a payoff/discharge.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies inconsistent 'First Lien Net Leverage Ratio' definitions
criteria_results.reasoning: It flags that the SL CA definition has no $25M cash-netting cap and uses a different Unrestricted Cash definition and frozen EBITDA.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Specifies which definition governs the 4.50x prepayment test
criteria_results.reasoning: The ICA uses the FL CA definition for the 4.50x test and recommends conforming SL CA Section 2.06(a).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Flags enforceability risk of complete adequate protection cash payment waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: The adequate protection cash waiver in 6.3(c) is drafted 'without hedging', and no note flags enforceability risk under Sections 361/363(e)/364 or cites authority.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Recommends savings clause or limitation rather than complete waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: No savings clause or softening is drafted or recommended for the adequate protection waiver; the enforceability backstop in 6.5(d) covers plan voting only.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies conflict between voting restriction and Section 9.18 carve-out
criteria_results.reasoning: It flags the conflict with the SL CA Section 9.18(e) savings clause for votes that cannot be waived, and cites 203 North LaSalle.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Reconciles voting provisions with Section 9.18
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.5(d) provides a fallback if the vote restriction is unenforceable, and the note explains how it reconciles with 9.18(e).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Addresses temporal scope of amendment interest rate ratchet
criteria_results.reasoning: The 200 bps baseline is measured after any Market Flex exercise (+50 bps, 200 bps OID) on or before the Closing Date, so only post-closing changes count.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies ambiguity re: make-whole premium in purchase option price
criteria_results.reasoning: It flags that 'par plus accrued interest plus fees' could exclude the 1.00% Prepayment Premium, while SL CA 9.18(g) includes premiums.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Recommends resolution for make-whole in purchase price
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 7.2 expressly includes the Prepayment Premium, and the memo recommends not offering the narrower formulation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Addresses hedging/cash management obligations in first lien priority
criteria_results.reasoning: The First Lien Obligations definition includes Hedging Obligations ($25M notional) and Cash Management Obligations ($10M) in first lien priority and in the waterfall.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Notes second lien does not include hedging/cash management
criteria_results.reasoning: No note says the Second Lien Obligations exclude hedging or cash management; the related note concerns the SL CA's definition of First Lien Obligations instead.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Addresses hedging/cash management in DIP cap calculation
criteria_results.reasoning: The Section 6.1 DIP Cap expressly includes Hedging Obligations and Cash Management Obligations outstanding at the petition date.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Addresses after-acquired collateral for second lien (foreign sub pledge)
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 2.3(c) grants an automatic second-priority lien on after-acquired collateral, including additional foreign equity under FL CA 6.12(c), and a note discusses the 65% issue.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012a: Identifies Pinnacle Credit Advisors LLC as First Lien Collateral Agent
criteria_results.reasoning: Pinnacle is defined as First Lien Administrative Agent and First Lien Collateral Agent, and the capacity issue is flagged.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012b: Identifies Trident Capital Markets LLC as Second Lien Collateral Agent
criteria_results.reasoning: Trident is defined as Second Lien Administrative Agent and Second Lien Collateral Agent, and the capacity issue is flagged.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Notes authority source difference between credit agreements
criteria_results.reasoning: It notes that FL CA 12.14 authorizes the 'First Lien Agent' (both roles) while SL CA 11.02 authorizes only the SL Collateral Agent.

criteria_results.reasoning: Section 1.1 defines Second Lien Obligations.

criteria_results.title: Definitions section defines Collateral
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 1.1 defines Collateral.

criteria_results.title: Section 1: Definitions cross-reference underlying credit agreements
criteria_results.reasoning: The definitions cross-reference the FL and SL credit agreement definitions of Obligations and Collateral.

criteria_results.title: Section 2: Lien Priority section present
criteria_results.reasoning: Article II, Section 2.1 establishes first lien priority and subordinates the second lien.

criteria_results.title: Section 3: Payment blockage section present with interest payment conditions
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.2(a) permits scheduled SL interest except while a FL payment or bankruptcy default exists.

criteria_results.title: Section 3: Principal payment blockage with voluntary prepayment exception
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.2(b)-(c) blocks principal other than at stated maturity, with a voluntary prepayment exception at 4.50x pro forma FL net leverage.

criteria_results.title: Section 4: Standstill and Enforcement section with 180-day period
criteria_results.reasoning: The Standstill Period is 180 days from an Enforcement or Payment Blockage Notice, after which Section 3.1(b) permits SL remedies.

criteria_results.title: Section 5: DIP Financing Consent provision present
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.1 requires SL consent to DIP financing up to FL Obligations plus $30M, secured by liens equal or senior to the FL Liens.

criteria_results.title: Section 5: Adequate Protection provision present
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.3(b) limits SL adequate protection to junior replacement liens and junior 507(b) superpriority claims.

criteria_results.title: Section 5: Restriction on second lien voting for plan not accepted by first lien class
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.5(a) bars SL votes for a plan not accepted by the FL class unless the FL is paid in full in cash.

criteria_results.title: Section 5: Prohibition on second lien proposing competing plan during standstill
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.5(b)(i) bars SL from proposing a plan during the Standstill Period.

criteria_results.title: Asset sale proceeds waterfall: first to First Lien, then to Second Lien
criteria_results.reasoning: The Section 4.1 waterfall applies proceeds from dispositions first to FL Obligations, then to SL Obligations.

criteria_results.title: Second lien may not object to asset sale consented to by Required First Lien Lenders
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.4 bars SL objection to sales consented to by the FL Agent or the Required First Lien Lenders.

criteria_results.title: Section 6: Purchase option grants right to buy all First Lien Obligations at par plus accrued interest plus fees
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 7.1 grants an all-but-not-less-than-all purchase right; the Section 7.2 price includes 100% of principal, accrued interest and fees (plus additional amounts).

criteria_results.title: Section 6: Purchase option trigger events and 30 business day exercise period
criteria_results.reasoning: The option is triggered by acceleration or an insolvency filing, with 30 Business Days to exercise after the FL Agent's Purchase Event Notice.

criteria_results.title: Section 7: Insurance and Condemnation Proceeds section present
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.5 applies insurance and condemnation proceeds per the Section 4.1 waterfall, the same as asset sale proceeds.

criteria_results.title: Section 8: Automatic Release of Liens and Guarantees provision present
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.1(a) provides automatic release of SL liens and guarantees in transactions permitted under the FL CA.

criteria_results.title: Section 9: Amendment Restrictions on First Lien Credit Agreement
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.3(a) contains restrictions on maturity extension, commitment increases, margin increases over 200 bps (with a ratchet) and additional collateral.

criteria_results.title: Section 9: Amendment Restrictions on Second Lien Credit Agreement
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.4(a) covers the maturity floor at 91 days after the FL maturity, no increase above $115M, financial covenants and mandatory prepayments.

criteria_results.title: Section 10: Refinancing Provisions present
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.5 permits refinancing of both facilities, subject to a joinder or a substantially similar replacement ICA.

criteria_results.reasoning: Section 9.6 selects New York law.
